augmentation: one uniformly random brightness/contrast/saturation, coefficient U(0.8,1.2), tensor RGB before ImageNet normalization
map_policy: development-normal q90/q99.5, resized maps, no clipping

proxy.interpretation: paired edits on training backgrounds; optimistic proxies, not held-out real-defect accuracy

selection.inputs: development normals and fit-derived proxies only; never calibration or official test
selection.technical_requirements: finite losses, maps and gradients, fixed fitting probe teacher and AE losses reduced, all development scores finite, each category proxy AUROC >= 0.65
selection.ranking: macro paired fit-proxy image AUROC; choose 3 epochs if within 0.02 of best eligible 9-epoch candidate, else 9; prefer combined_max when within 0.02 of local_max at selected budget
selection.no_eligible_candidate: NO-GO, retain best diagnostic configuration without authorizing final benchmark

threshold_policy.scope: reserved calibration normals only after configuration selection

methods: synchronized wall and CUDA events resident input
file decode through CPU map end-to-end

final_gate.policy: GO only if technical proxy requirements and conservative total including CPU evaluation overhead <= 12h; no final models launched by development code
